We’ll reuse the existing CSV serializer and paging, with the Export CSV button beside the report title. Dropping the performance requirement changes an explicit acceptance criterion in acme/widgets#77, so we need to record that scope decision before the design rounds.

How should we handle “The export of a 10k-row report completes in under 60s.”?
A) in-scope - retain the 10k-row, under-60s requirement this sprint.
B) deviates: the 10k-row, under-60s requirement is excluded from this sprint.
C) deferred: acme/widgets#77 - retain this requirement there as unfinished follow-up work.
D) repair the ticket - `/skill:shape-ticket acme/widgets#77` to revise this row to match the intended sprint scope.
Recommendation: D - align the ticket with your intended scope before designing and implementing the export.
